# Claude SEO + AEO + GEO Kit

> Free, open-source kit for Claude Code: 82 skills for SEO, AEO (answer engines), GEO (AI search) and VEO (voice), plus a command-line auditor that scores any page 0-100 across SEO, AEO and GEO. MIT licensed. Runs locally.

## Use it
- Audit a page: `npx seo-aeo-geo-kit audit <url>` (add `--summary` for score and top fixes, `--json` for machine output)
- Install in Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add alpit-patel/seo-aeo-geo-kit` then `/plugin install seo-aeo-geo-kit@seo-aeo-geo-kit`
- Copy skills only: `npx seo-aeo-geo-kit install --only geo`
